facets.label: Issue types
facets.description: Food-safety and fraud issue categories assigned to event objects.

groups.name: Food fraud and authenticity
groups.definition: Issues concerning product identity, composition, substitution, dilution, or fraudulent presentation.

entries.name: Adulteration
entries.definition: A substance, process, or product condition is reported as compromising the food.

entries.name: Mislabeling
entries.definition: The label, identity, composition, or declaration does not match the reported product.

entries.name: Substitution
entries.definition: The expected food or ingredient is replaced wholly or partly by another material.

entries.name: Counterfeit
entries.definition: A product is presented as an authentic brand or food when it is allegedly fake.

entries.name: Dilution
entries.definition: The product is weakened by adding a lower-value or undeclared material.

groups.name: Food safety and quality
groups.definition: Issues concerning contamination, standards, prohibited additives, or unsafe product condition.

entries.name: Substandard
entries.definition: The product is reported as failing a quality, composition, or safety requirement.

entries.name: Unsafe food
entries.definition: The report describes a concrete food-safety concern without a narrower issue type.

entries.name: Contamination
entries.definition: The product contains an unwanted physical, chemical, or biological contaminant.

entries.name: Prohibited additive
entries.definition: The report identifies an additive that is not permitted for the stated use.

facets.label: Claim status
facets.description: How strongly the article presents the event claim, kept separate from relevance.

groups.name: Unconfirmed or qualified finding
groups.definition: Suspected, alleged, pending, or otherwise unresolved claims.

entries.name: Suspected
entries.definition: A concrete event is reported, but the issue remains a suspicion rather than a confirmed result.

entries.name: Alleged
entries.definition: The source attributes the issue as an allegation.

entries.name: Unclear
entries.definition: The available evidence does not establish one more specific status.

entries.name: Pending test
entries.definition: The target product has been sent for testing and no final result is reported.

groups.name: Confirmed finding
groups.definition: Claims presented as supported by a reported laboratory result.

entries.name: Lab confirmed
entries.definition: A laboratory result is reported as confirming the finding.
